name: Mori (Hokkaido, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Mori town emblem in green and blue: three overlapping green arches with blue inner strokes, like a forest.
history: Municipal flag of Mori, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 29 September 2005.

features.role: Mori town emblem — three overlapping green arches with blue inner strokes, like a forest
